svg.title: X7 - Molex HSAutoLink II 12-circuit right-angle header, key option A - mating face wireframe
svg.desc: Front (mating-face) view of the Molex HSAutoLink II 12-circuit right-angle unsealed header (series 34861), key option A. Geometry and dimensions are the Molex drawing sheet 2 (front view with dimensions).
svg.text: X7 — Molex HSAutoLink II 12-circuit R/A header · key option A
Mating-face (front) view · A11 Radio (IOK) Center Stack LVDS · Molex series 34861 (34861-1106 / -1306) · geometry and dimensions from sheet 2
Top-centre key tab below the housing top
Pins 1-6: top row, left to right (1.27 mm pitch).
Pins 7-12: bottom row, left to right, staggered
0.635 mm to the left of the top row.
Number sits to the right of its contact.
Pin assignment — GM manual, A11 Radio X7 (IOK)
Wire size and colour are not given in the manual (shown
“—”). Harness: Instrument Panel Wiring Harness; OEM
Header data — from the Molex drawing
Housing SPS 30% GF · terminals Cu alloy, selective gold

Source: Molex series 34861 drawing, sheet 2 (front view with dimensions) — the geometry above is the manufacturer's own vector drawing, redrawn in black on white. Dimensions 18.20, 12.49, 14.40, 9.15, 1.29, 2.80,
balloons 2-7 and the CIRCUIT #1/#6/#7/#12 callouts are Molex's.

Contact centres were measured on that drawing: 1.27 mm pitch, 0.635 mm row stagger, row separation ≈1.6 mm — not dimensioned by Molex. Key option A was specified by the design owner. Pins 1-6 (bold numerals) are the
ones the GM manual lists as occupied.
Note: Molex lists option A as black (34861-1106/-1306), while the GM manual describes the X7 harness connector as GY (gray). Verify the colour/key against the physical part.
